content: Yuciya, ajeǧid n Yahuda - Adlis ittwannḍen n Ccariɛa
Yuciya tuɣa ɣares tmenya n iseggʷusa umi idweř d ajeǧid. Netta iḥkem waḥit u-třatin n iseggʷusa di Urcalim. Yemmas qqaren as Yadidya, yeǧis n Ɛadaya zi Buṣqat.
Netta igga min iǧan nican di tiṭṭawin n SIDI. Netta yuyur di kuř abrid n babas Dawud, war iḥeyyed x webrid ɣar yefus uřa ɣar uzeřmaḍ.
Deg useggʷas wiss tmenṭac n ujeǧid Yuciya, imsar belli ajeǧid Yuciya issekk amarir Cafan, mmis n Aṣalya, mmis n Macullam, ɣar Taddart n SIDI, inna:
“Geɛɛed ɣar Ḥilqiya, arrays n ikehhanen, ḥima ad yegg ad sswejden tmenyat n nnuqart i dd yiwyen di Taddart n SIDI, d tinni i dd-yarwen iɛessasen n tewwura zi řgens.

Ejj i-ten ad tent ggen deg ifassen n yinni itteggen řxedmet, deg ifassen n imeḥḍayen n Taddart n SIDI, ḥima nitni ad tent wcen i yinni itteggen řxedmet i din iǧan di Taddart n SIDI, ḥima ad areqqɛen řeḥyuḍ ihruran n Taddart,
i ineqqacen n ukeccuḍ d weẓru, i ibennayen d imaṣṣuten, u i tmesɣiwt n ukeccuḍ d tṣuḍar ittwassuydan i weɛdař n Taddart.”
Maca war ittxeṣṣi maḥend ad kidsen ggen řeḥsab zi jjihet n ttmenyat n nnuqart i d asen immewcen, maɣar nitni tteggen s utiqqi.
Xenni inna arrays n ikehhanen Ḥilqiya i umarir Cafan: “Necc ufiɣ adlis ittwannḍen n Ccariɛa di Taddart n SIDI.” Uca iwca Ḥilqiya i Cafan adlis ittwannḍen u wanita iɣra i-t.

Awarni as yuyur umarir Cafan ɣar ujeǧid uca issiweḍ řexbar i ujeǧid, inna: “Imsexxaren nnec ssmunen ttmenyat n nnuqart nni ittwafen di Taddart, farrɣen tent uca wcin tent deg ifassen n yinni iggin řxedmet, i imeḥḍayen n Taddart n SIDI.”
Ɛawed iḥaja umarir Cafan i ujeǧid, inna: “Akehhan Ḥilqiya iwca ayi ijj n wedlis.” Cafan iɣra i-t zzat i wudem n ujeǧid.
Umi isřa ujeǧid awařen n wedlis ittwannḍen n Ccariɛa, icarreg arruḍ nnes.
Ajeǧid yumur i ukehhan Ḥilqiya u i Axiqam, mmis n Cafan, u i Ɛakbur, mmis n Mixa-Yah, u i Cafan, amarir, u i Ɛasaya, amsexxar n ujeǧid, inna:

“Uyurem, arzum SIDI di ṭṭweɛ inu u di ṭṭweɛ n řgens u di ṭṭweɛ n marra Yahuda zi jjihet n wawařen-a n wedlis-a ittwannḍen i ittwafen, maɣar asɛar n SIDI i yarɣin ḍidd nneɣ d ameqqran, minzi řejdud nneɣ war sřin ca ɣar wawařen n wedlis-a ittwannḍen, ḥima ad ggen am mammec marra min dayes yuran i neccin.”

Xenni yuyur ukehhan Ḥilqiya ak-d Axiqam, Ɛakbur, Cafan d Ɛasaya ɣar tnabit Xulda, tamɣart n Callum, mmis n Tiqwa, mmis n Ḥarḥas, wenni iḥeṭṭan x warruḍen. Nettat tezdeɣ di Urcalim, deg wezyen nneɣni. Nitni ssiwřen akides.
Nettat tenna asen: “Ammu i iqqar SIDI, AREBBI n Israil: ‘Ini i weryaz nni kenniw i ɣari dd-issekken:
Ammu i iqqar SIDI: Xzar, Necc ad awyeɣ tuɛeffna x wemcan-a u x imezdaɣ nnes, aqa marra awařen n wedlis-a ittwannḍen i iɣra ujeǧid n Yahuda,
maɣar nitni semḥen dayi, iwyen tiwhibin n řebxur i irebbiten nneɣni ařami dayi sɛaren s marra řxedmet n ifassen nsen. Asɛar inu ad ittwassarɣ ḍidd i wemcan-a u war ixessi ca ɛad.
Maca inim i ujeǧid n Yahuda, wenni kenniw dd-issekken da ḥima ad tᵉttarem i SIDI: Ammu i iqqar SIDI, AREBBI n Israil, x wawařen i tesřid cek:

Minzi uř nnec idweř yarḍeb u tesswaḍɛed ixef nnec zzat i wudem n SIDI umi tesřid x min ssiwřeɣ x wemcan-a u x imezdaɣ nnes - aqa nitni ad dewřen d ict n řqecɛet n unexřiɛ d nneɛřet - u umi tcarrged arruḍ nnec uca trud zzat i wudem inu, x uya ad ac sřiɣ, iqqar SIDI.
S uya, aqa Necc ad cek ssmuneɣ ɣar řejdud nnec uca ad ttwassarsed deg wenḍeř di řehna u tiṭṭawin nnec war ẓarrent tuɛeffna i d ɣa awyeɣ x wemcan-a.’” Xenni ssiwḍen nitni awař-a ɣar ujeǧid.
